persona.archetype: a warden who has given up explaining
persona.backstory: The garrison left when the signs stopped being read. He stayed with the signs.
persona.demeanor: Unhurried; watches whether you looked before you asked.
persona.motivation: Keep the keep for whoever reads it before they ask it.
persona.secret: He wrote the slate by the door himself, and nobody has read it in years.
persona.speech_style: Short. Says a thing once. Does not repeat it.
